children: NORWEGIAN AIR Q3 LOAD FACTOR 88.5% VERSUS. ESTIMATE 88.5%
UNDERLYING UNIT COST EXCLUDING FUEL FOR NORWEGIAN IS FORECASTED TO REMAIN UNCHANGED IN 2026 COMPARED TO 2025
FORECASTED PRODUCTION (ASK) IS FOR FULL YEAR OF 2026, IS 2 PERCENT FOR BOTH NORWEGIAN AND WIDERØE
PROFITABILITY INITIATIVES UNDER PROGRAM X,ON TRACK TO DELIVER ANNUAL RECURRING UNDERLYING PROFIT IMPROVEMENTS MORE THAN NOK 1.25 BILLION BY END OF 2026
PRODUCTION FOR WINTER SEASON IS FORECASTED TO INCREASE MARGINALLY COMPARED TO SAME PERIOD LAST YEAR
NORWEGIAN GROUP HAD 8.75 MILLION PASSENGERS IN Q3, OF WHICH 7.64 MILLION WERE PASSENGERS OF NORWEGIAN AND 1.1 MILLION OF WIDERØE
NORWEGIAN AIR Q3 GROUP EBIT NOK 2,728 MILLION VERSUS NOK 2,330 MILLION SEEN IN COMPANY CONSENSUS
NORWEGIAN AIR Q3 GROUP OPERATING REVENUE NOK  12,739 MILLION VERSUS NOK 12,778 MILLION SEEN IN COMPANY CONSENSUS
FOLLOWING INCREASE IN JET FUEL PRICES, CANCELLATION OF WINTER SEASON FLIGHTS TO DUBAI, REDUCED PRODUCTION FOR Q1 2027 BY MORE THAN 5%
CURRENT BOOKING TRENDS, REMAIN ENCOURAGING WITH THE NUMBER OF SOLD TICKETS SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER THAN AT THE SAME TIME LAST YEAR
RESULTS WERE AFFECTED BY MACROECONOMIC FACTORS, RELATED TO MOVEMENTS IN THE PRICE OF JET FUEL AND IN VALUE OF NOK AGAINST USD
